## Professional Summary

Darshita Singh is a B.Tech Information Technology graduate from Jaipur Engineering College and Research Centre (JECRC Foundation), graduating in 2026 with a CGPA of 8.72/10.

She is a full-stack developer with hands-on experience across the MERN stack, Django REST Framework, TypeScript, and AI-powered integrations. She has worked at Zyoris Technology on an AI-powered CRM platform, at Pracverse Pvt. Ltd. on STEM and technology education, and at REGEX Software on full-stack web development.

Her technical approach combines engineering precision with a strong interest in UI design and user experience. She positions herself as a UI/UX-focused full-stack developer who cares about how products feel, not just whether they work.

## Projects

### Vrinda Valley Resort
Category: Full-Stack Web Development
Stack: React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express 5, MongoDB Atlas, Cloudinary, Netlify, Render
Problem: A luxury resort in Jaipur needed a complete digital presence from scratch — public-facing booking site and admin dashboard.
Approach: Built end-to-end. Responsive site, booking workflow, admin dashboard for bookings/photos/reviews/blog/SEO content, rule-based chatbot using intent classification and state machine (no external AI API), server-side session authentication.
Achievement: Content payload reduced from ~5 MB to 11 KB.
Live URL: https://www.vrindavalleyresort.com/

### DevJobsBoard
Category: Full-Stack Development + AI-Assisted Resume Processing
Stack: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Django REST Framework, Anthropic Claude API, Render
Problem: Developers need to discover jobs across platforms and understand if their resume passes ATS filters.
Approach: Job aggregation with multi-filter search, JWT authentication, ATS resume-tailoring engine. All PDF/DOCX parsing and scoring runs client-side — documents never leave the browser.
Live URL: https://devjobsboard-web.onrender.com/

### Manova Mental Wellness
Category: Frontend Engineering + Digital Wellness
Stack: React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Framer Motion, EmailJS
Problem: A licensed psychologist needed a professional website with appointment booking and self-help tools.
Approach: Four-step animated booking, browser-based mood journal, PHQ-9 check-in, guided breathing, dual-email delivery, bilingual English/Hindi crisis-detection chatbot, full accessibility.
